sonnet.problem: The card says "The LORD asks, 'Will not the land quake for this...'" and "Then He says" the land will swell like the Nile. In the BSB, the LORD's sworn quote closes at the end of 8:7. Verse 8 has no quotation marks and no speaker, so the text doesn't say the LORD is the one asking or speaking.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to guess the exact verb in "will ___ from thirst." No earlier card sets up this verse, so nothing lets the baker reason their way to "faint," and the wrong answers "cry" and "beg" barely fit the sentence. The pick comes down to luck.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.
